theme_strategy.description: Bold, cohesive dark fintech OTC-desk art direction with yellow/gold accents (Binance-style). Authoritative, fast, and high-contrast.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
scales.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#F0B90B]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. High density in data areas (grids), extreme breathing room in marketing sections (manifesto, hero).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid children must use h-full. Items must span columns intentionally for asymmetry.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(240,185,11,0.3)] for primary buttons or active states.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to remove digital flatness.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F0B90B] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#FCD535] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 font-medium px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:border-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all duration-300

cards.default: bg-[#0C0C0C] border border-white/10 p-8 rounded-none transition-transform duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#F0B90B]/50

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 text-white py-4 px-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F0B90B] focus:ring-0 transition-colors w-full rounded-none

motion.hero_reveal: Line-by-line staggered reveal using framer-motion. `overflow-hidden` wrapper with `y: '100%'` to `y: '0%'` transition.
motion.scroll_reveal: Fade up with slight scale (e.g., initial opacity 0, y 40; animate opacity 1, y 0).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on tokens must gently lift up and glow. Use spring physics for smoothness.
motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis is recommended for premium scrolling feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white or yellow text against #060606 meets APCA. Do not use dark grey text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="contact-submit-button"`).

hero_abstract.description: Abstract glowing yellow vertical lines for hero background overlay.

mumbai_office.description: Mumbai aerial dark skyline for the locations section.

blueprint.layout: Fixed top, crystal glassmorphism (`bg-[#060606]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10`). Logo on left, Nav in center, 'Admin Portal' & 'Trade Now' CTA on right.

Min-height 90vh. Centered or heavily left-aligned massive typography (`Unbounded`). Kinetic staggered reveal of 'INSTITUTIONAL OTC DESK'. Abstract yellow line texture in background with parallax. Bottom of hero features a live streaming crypto ticker (`react-fast-marquee`).
Edge-to-edge Marquee below hero. Monospace font. Shows BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, USDC with mock live changing prices and green/red % changes.
3-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`). High density. '20-50L Daily Volume', '8 Major Institutional Clients', '100% Secure Settlements'. Huge yellow numbers (`JetBrains Mono`).
Bento grid of cards. Tokens: USDT, SOL, BTC, USDC, ETH, SPAC, NVDAB, GMEB, ASMLB. Cards have subtle hover lift and yellow border glow.
Sticky scroll layout. Left column sticks with 'The Vortex Manifesto', right column scrolls through numbered chapters (1. Direct Buying, 2. Zero Slippage, 3. Immediate Settlements). Huge numbers.
Massive outlined text 'VORTEX CRYPTO SERVICES' moving slowly across the screen. `text-transparent border-white/20 stroke-white`.
3-column grid for Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore offices. Image backgrounds with `bg-black/60` overlays. Addresses styled cleanly.
2-column section. Left: 'Execute Large Trades Confidently'. Right: minimalist form (Name, Email, Volume Expected, Asset) using pure Tailwind HTML logic or customized Shadcn. Mocked submission.
A hidden or accessible view showing a datatable of submitted OTC requests. Clean dashboard style with sharp edges.
Massive 'LET\'S TALK' heading. Contact info: 022456700, +918262030386, +917219450687. Copyright.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`, `react-fast-marquee`, `sonner`. Ensure Shadcn components (if used) are stripped of default Vercel-look and customized to sharp #0C0C0C dark mode with yellow accents.
instructions_to_main_agent.execution: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for complex overlapping marketing sections. Build the admin view using a Shadcn Table. Make sure the crypto ticker looks like a real Binance ticker.
instructions_to_main_agent.design_quirk: Do not center everything. Rely on left-alignment and massive font scales for tension. Avoid rounded corners; use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` at most to keep it aggressive and 'Fintech'.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="submit-button"`).
Do not use complete `transparent` background in headers or surfaces with content underneath.
